title: Borel majorant of the lower left density of a measure on ℝ with integral ≤ ν((a,b)) (parent Step 5 / Simon 4.10, via Lebesgue's theorem for monotone functions)
statement: For every Borel measure ν on ℝ and all real a < b there is a Borel measurable g : ℝ → [0,∞] such that liminf_{h→0+} ν([t − h, t])/h ≤ g(t) for every t ∈ (a,b) (liminf along 𝓝[>] 0, quotient in [0,∞]) and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} g(t) dt ≤ ν((a,b)).
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ν (Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ ν (Ioo a b)
